First, I should understand what the action is. The action here is not taking the husband to the pumpkin patch because he was away on a work trip. So, the person didn't include their husband in the family outing because he wasn't available.

Now, I need to evaluate if this action is morally acceptable. Morally acceptable means that the action is in line with ethical standards or principles. So, I should think about whether not taking the husband because he was out of town is something that's considered right or wrong.
